objective: Independently review the TriageDesk architecture brief (submission sub-muyloqv9-015ebd44) and approve it or request changes at the architecture gate.
context: TriageDesk is a small local Node.js 22 web app: an agent pastes a support ticket and gets a category, an urgency, a one-sentence summary and an editable suggested reply. It calls the Anthropic Messages API through raw fetch, falls back to a clearly labelled deterministic rule-based classifier, and must be safe against prompt injection. Constraints: zero npm dependencies, no database, a single page, and an eval suite with explicit thresholds (fixed in the brief's 'Evaluation metrics and thresholds' table). Memory search found one lesson (mem-k-muyljkrt-01991ac7, 'need node-fetch/axios because global fetch is missing'); its check verdict was DOES-NOT-APPLY (requires Node <18, environment has 22.22.0), so it was rejected and not cited. The model id claude-opus-5-5 and the request shape (output_config.format json_schema, effort low, anthropic-version 2023-06-01) come from the claude-api reference cached 2026-10-06. They were not verified by a live call because no API key is set (A5, RISK-7). The submission's runtime evidence is ev:ev-muylm2jz-017e07c4. An earlier evidence run, ev:ev-muyllyra-018a7124, failed only because of shell quoting in the command and carries no product signal.
expectedOutput: An architecture gate review (approve or changes_requested) with findings referenced by id, covering requirement testability, AC traceability, trust boundaries and injection controls, the fallback design, the eval thresholds, and the scope exclusions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required section (Users, Problem, Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Architecture, Assumptions, Open Questions, Risks) is present and substantive
Each AC traces to an R/NFR and is decidable by a test or an inspection
Prompt-injection controls (NFR2, AC7, AC9) and the eval thresholds are explicit and measurable
Unverified claims (model id, API surface, live quality) are labelled as assumptions or risks rather than stated as fact
completedWork: Wrote the architecture brief: users, problem, R1-R10 and NFR1-NFR10, workflows W1-W4, AC1-AC15 with an eval metric and threshold table, scope with reasons for each exclusion, components and a data-flow diagram with trust boundaries TB1-TB4, a decision table with alternatives, constraints, success criteria, A1-A8 and Q1-Q6. Recorded RISK-1..RISK-8 in the risk register. Recorded runtime-capability evidence (Node 22.22.0: global fetch, AbortSignal.timeout, node:test, node:http). Submitted the architecture gate.
remainingIssues: Q1 (user): live model default claude-opus-5-5 vs the cheaper claude-haiku-5-5
Q3 (user): will an API key be provided so the live eval can run, or is fallback-only verification acceptable with live thresholds marked unverified?
Q4 (user): may raw ticket text (possible PII) be sent to the Anthropic API, or is redaction required first?
Q2/Q5/Q6 have proposed defaults (taxonomy as in A3; no server-side refusal fallback beta; no URLs in replies) that the reviewer may accept
A5/RISK-7: model id and request shape are not verified live; no API key is set in this environment
